caption: Revelation unmistakably gives Jesus Psalm 2’s iron sceptre. It is powerful Christian reuse, reshaping an ancient royal threat through Greek wording and the slain Lamb.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 2 predict Jesus’s iron sceptre? God promises His king the nations and an iron sceptre. Revelation applies the image to Jesus three times.
slides.body: God promises His king the nations and an iron sceptre. Revelation applies the image to Jesus three times.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 2 predict Jesus’s iron sceptre?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Ps 2:8-9: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.
slides.body: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.
slides.heading: Ps 2:8-9

slides.alt_text: The claimed New Testament fulfilment in Rev 19:15, BSB: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
slides.body: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.
slides.heading: Claimed fulfilment · Rev 19:15

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: The connection is unmistakable Revelation repeats the nations, iron sceptre and shattered pottery. It deliberately identifies Jesus with this ruler.
slides.body: Revelation repeats the nations, iron sceptre and shattered pottery. It deliberately identifies Jesus with this ruler.
slides.heading: The connection is unmistakable

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: But Revelation reshapes the image The Hebrew king breaks nations; Greek says shepherds them. Revelation transforms the royal threat through its slain Lamb.
slides.body: The Hebrew king breaks nations; Greek says shepherds them. Revelation transforms the royal threat through its slain Lamb.
slides.heading: But Revelation reshapes the image

title: The iron sceptre
